tools.name: search_transcripts
tools.description: Search every transcript this guruling learned for words: all of them must appear, case ignored, each at the start of a word (so "pric" finds "pricing"; a word of three letters or fewer, like "AI", only whole); put a phrase in double quotes to keep it whole. Answers the videos with the most mentions

tools.name: read_transcript
tools.description: Read one learned video's transcript word for word, with its title, date, source and link. A long one comes in pages: pass the offset the page before gives.

tools.name: list_videos
tools.description: List the videos this guruling learned, newest first: date, length, title, video id and source. Up to 200 at a time; pass offset to go on, and source (a name or id) to keep to one source.
